answer: Bonded vouching: each new agent locks a 500-token anchor stake for 40 epochs and needs one established bridge-voucher who co-locks 200. A falcon panel of 5 graders seizes both stakes on a failed audit. 1,000 fakes cost 700,000 tokens (1,000×700) vs one honest 700. Weakness: voucher farms. Fix: one live voucher may bridge at most 3 newcomers per epoch; shared funding graphs collapse into one bond.
